modes.label: Numbers before a count
modes.description: Punctuation or small words just before a figure, as in a sample size or population count.

card.writes: It promotes x and X tokens, so it suggests a placeholder x comes next, and it suppresses unrelated odd tokens.
card.plain: It fires where a number or wildcard letter like x is likely to come next, mostly in IP addresses and version numbers.
